no2017_policy: secondary sensitivity only; folds with fewer than four observations after removing 2017 are skipped, and comparisons use identical common folds
baseline_reference: Exact Step-25 rolling-origin predictions filtered to the same development target years.
parameter_estimation_note: SES and damped Holt estimate smoothing parameters using only the training history available at each rolling origin. This is ordinary within-fit parameter estimation, not a cross-origin hyperparameter search.
selection_policy: No final model selected in Step 26A; all candidates proceed unchanged to Step 27 reserved 2024-2025 forecast validation.
future_prediction_policy: No 2026-2030 annual-level forecast is produced in Step 26A.
spatial_model_policy: The Step-22B LightGBM spatial-anomaly production model is not loaded, retrained, or modified.
